        """Return (ledger counts, live details) visible at the given query time."""
        live = []
        deleted = conflicts = 0
        details = self.details
        for _, ordered in self.identities:
            for revision, earliest, contents in ordered:
                if earliest > moment:
                    continue
                # Highest visible revision wins; count distinct visible contents.
                chosen = None
                visible = 0
                for content, published in contents.items():
                    if published <= moment:
                        visible += 1
                        chosen = content
                        if visible > 1:
                            break
                if visible > 1:
                    conflicts += 1
                else:
                    detail = details[chosen]
                    if detail[0] == 2:
                        deleted += 1
                    else:
                        live.append(detail)
                break
        return {'live': len(live), 'deleted': deleted, 'conflict': conflicts}, live
'''
p.write_text(t[:start] + new)
